_note: Invented questionnaires for the clickable sample only. They are not validated measures, are not drawn from any published instrument, and must never be used with clients.

items.text: I start my working day at a similar time.
I find it hard to get going in the morning.
I have a regular way of keeping track of what I need to do.
Small household tasks pile up before I get to them.
I take breaks during the day before I feel worn out.
My evenings run late and leave me tired the next day.

subscales.label: Structure in your day
subscales.strengthReason: You described a steady rhythm to your day that you can build on.
subscales.focusReason: Your answers suggest your day has little fixed structure, which can make everything else harder.

subscales.label: Getting started and keeping up
subscales.strengthReason: You told us that getting started and keeping on top of small tasks mostly goes smoothly.
subscales.focusReason: Starting tasks and keeping on top of small jobs came up often in your answers.

measures.name: Focus and planning
measures.description: Sample questionnaire about focus and planning at work.
measures.instructions: Think about your work over the last 2 weeks.

items.text: I break larger pieces of work into smaller steps.
I lose track of what I was doing after an interruption.
I underestimate how long work will take.
I can stay with a task I find interesting for a long time.
I leave important work until close to the deadline.
I plan my week before it begins.
Notifications pull me away from what I am working on.
I return to a task quickly after a break.

subscales.label: Planning ahead
subscales.strengthReason: You described planning habits that already help you get work done on time.
subscales.focusReason: Estimating time and leaving work late came up often in your answers.

subscales.label: Holding your focus
subscales.strengthReason: You told us you can stay with your work and come back to it easily.
subscales.focusReason: Interruptions and notifications pulling you away came up often in your answers.
